nodes.description: UniswapExchange.transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable; forwards msg.sender to transferFrom
UniswapExchange.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) public payable; checks allowance, ensure(), then updates balanceOf and _onSaleNum with raw arithmetic
UniswapExchange.ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) internal view; whitelist bypass for owner, UNI, computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale, otherwise calls condition()
UniswapExchange.condition(address _from, uint _value) internal view; enforces _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and per-address _onSaleNum limits
UniswapExchange.approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable; sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] unconditionally
UniswapExchange.delegate(address a, bytes b) public payable; owner-only delegatecall to an arbitrary attacker-chosen address and calldata
UniswapExchange.init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) owner-only; sets sale limits with unchecked multiplication by 10**decimals
UniswapExchange.batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) public payable; owner-only loop performing unchecked multiplication and unchecked balance updates
UniswapExchange.setTradeAddress(address addr) owner-only; writes tradeAddress used in the ensure() whitelist
UniswapExchange.pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure; deterministic CREATE2 pair address computation
UniswapExchange constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint256 _supply) payable; mints totalSupply to msg.sender and sets owner
address private owner; source of all owner-only authorization checks and whitelist bypass in ensure()
mapping(address => uint) public balanceOf; mutated with unchecked += / -= arithmetic
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) public allowance; read and decremented in transferFrom and written in approve
mapping(address => bool) private canSale; whitelist bypass consulted by ensure()
address tradeAddress; settable whitelist entry used by ensure()
mapping(address => uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-sender sale counter incremented in transferFrom
uint256 private _saleNum; max number of sales per address, set in init()
uint256 private _minSale; minimum sale amount, set in init()
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum sale amount, set in init()
uint public totalSupply; assigned in the constructor with an unchecked 10**decimals multiplication
msg.sender; used for authorization checks, allowance owner, and as transfer origin
a.delegatecall(b) in delegate(); arbitrary external code executed in the context of this contract
balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom; raw unchecked subtraction without SafeMath
balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom; raw unchecked addition without SafeMath
uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend; unchecked multiplication that can overflow
_from parameter of transferFrom/ensure/condition
_to parameter of transfer/transferFrom/ensure
_value parameter of transfer/transferFrom/ensure/condition/approve/batchSend
_spender parameter of approve
_tos address array parameter of batchSend
a address parameter of delegate; delegatecall target
b bytes parameter of delegate; delegatecall calldata
saleNum parameter of init
token parameter of init; scaled into _minSale
maxToken parameter of init; scaled into _maxSale
addr parameter of setTradeAddress
uint total in batchSend; result of unchecked _value * _tos.length
uint i loop counter in batchSend
address _to loop variable in batchSend
address _UNI in ensure(); computed pair address used in the whitelist check

edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom
msg.sender is compared with _from and used to load and decrement allowance[_from][msg.sender]
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] under caller control
delegate is guarded only by require(msg.sender == owner)
init is guarded only by require(msg.sender == owner)
batchSend is guarded only by require(msg.sender == owner)
setTradeAddress is guarded only by require(msg.sender == owner)
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints totalSupply to msg.sender
externally callable transfer re-enters the public transferFrom entry point
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before state mutation
ensure falls through to condition(_from,_value) when the whitelist does not pass
transferFrom executes the unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value statement
transferFrom executes the unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value statement
balanceOf mapping is the storage target of the unchecked subtraction
balanceOf mapping is the storage target of the unchecked addition
batchSend reads and writes balanceOf[msg.sender] and balanceOf[_to] with raw arithmetic
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] without overflow protection
_value is added to balanceOf[_to] without overflow protection
_value is a factor of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend
_tos.length is a factor of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend
batchSend executes uint total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath
_tos array is iterated to credit recipients in batchSend
_from determines whose allowance and balance are debited
_from is tested against owner, UNI, the computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale
_to receives the credited balance
_to is tested against owner in the ensure whitelist bypass
_value is the amount transferred and validated by ensure/condition
_spender indexes the allowance mapping written by approve
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is required >= _value and then decremented
approve overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
canSale[_from] grants a whitelist bypass of the sale limits in ensure
owner/_from or owner/_to comparisons let the owner bypass all sale conditions
tradeAddress grants a whitelist bypass of the sale limits in ensure
_onSaleNum[_from] is incremented on every successful transferFrom
_saleNum bounds the per-address sale count in condition
_minSale lower-bounds _value in condition
_maxSale upper-bounds _value in condition
delegate performs a.delegatecall(b), executing arbitrary code in this contract's storage context
parameter a is the caller-supplied delegatecall target address
parameter b is the caller-supplied delegatecall calldata
pairFor is used by ensure to compute the _UNI pair address checked in the whitelist
saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum
token parameter is multiplied by 10**decimals without checked arithmetic
maxToken parameter is multiplied by 10**decimals without checked arithmetic
addr parameter becomes the whitelist-bypassing tradeAddress
local total carries the overflowed _value * _tos.length result used as the balance check

normalization_plan.reason: _from is a local parameter consumed only by transferFrom and its ensure/condition helpers
_to is a local parameter consumed only by transferFrom and its ensure helper
_value is a local parameter consumed by transferFrom and its condition helper
_spender is a local parameter used only as the allowance index in approve
_tos is a local parameter iterated only inside batchSend
a is a local parameter used only as the delegatecall target in delegate
b is a local parameter used only as the delegatecall calldata in delegate
saleNum is a local parameter assigned to _saleNum only inside init
token is a local parameter scaled into _minSale only inside init
maxToken is a local parameter scaled into _maxSale only inside init
addr is a local parameter stored into tradeAddress only inside setTradeAddress
total is the temporary result of the unchecked multiplication unsafe operation in batchSend
i is the loop counter belonging to the batchSend loop body
_to is the per-iteration recipient variable belonging to batchSend
_UNI is the temporary computed pair address used only inside the ensure whitelist check
